continue.description: false sends the teammate idle with the task still in progress when a teammate finishing its turn triggered the event, even if another matching hook blocks or this hook exits 2; ignored when the TaskUpdate tool triggered it.

reason.description: Returned to Claude when decision is block, and the task stays open.

stopReason.description: Appears in the teammate's transcript when continue false sends the teammate idle; never shown when the TaskUpdate tool triggered the event.
